nodes.question: Why is the production of electric cars currently a bottleneck in the transition to e-vehicles?
nodes.answer: The production of electric cars is currently a bottleneck in the transition to e-vehicles because current batteries require lithium and the supply of lithium is limited in terms of both quantity and quality.
